actions.action: Paper tap test under a frond to check for moving specks
Inspect leaflet undersides with macro lens or loupe for mites/webbing
Wipe a leaf with damp white tissue to check for red smears
Isolate the plant from other plants
Rinse plant in shower/sink, tops and undersides of fronds
Wipe leaflets with damp cloth, especially undersides
